pages.text: $(thing)Quantum Chemistry$()$(br2)Solve the Schrödinger equation for a molecule and you have its chemistry. Unlocks orbital lattices and chiral crystals.

$(thing)Insight$(): 35$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Chemical Bonding, Quantum Entanglement.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Qubit.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A single electron of mass m is bound to a proton by the electrostatic attraction. Write the stationary wave equation: the kinetic-energy operator plus the potential energy acting on the wavefunction ψ, which must equal E times ψ.
